basic_details.job_title: CSIR-IIIM Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine (CSIR-IIIM), Jammu, has invited applications for two Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Med.) posts, one in Biology and one in Chemistry, under the ICMR-funded project No. GAP-3183 on anti-TB scaffolds. Pay is ₹56,000 per month plus HRA, the upper age limit is 35 years, selection is by interview on MS Teams, and applications are open until 18 November 2026 through the "Click to Apply" link.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 35 years for both posts. Age is reckoned as on the last date of application. Relaxation in age limit is given as per Govt. of India Rules; the notice prints no category-wise relaxation. | All applicants must fulfil the essential qualification and other conditions as on the date of interview. Before applying, they should ensure they hold at least the essential qualifications as on the last date of application. For discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

how_to_apply: Find the post you want in the vacancy table of the official notification (post code 01 Biology or post code 02 Chemistry).
Use the "Click to Apply" link printed against that post in the notice.
For queries on post code 1, email Dr. Rashmi Sharma at [email protected]. For queries on post code 2, email Dr. Parvinder Pal Singh at [email protected].
The notice does not list the fields of the online form or any documents to attach at the application stage.
important_instructions: Candidates currently engaged in any project at CSIR-IIIM must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) before applying for any new vacancy. Their application, candidature or selection is considered only if the office has issued the NOC. Canvassing in any form is treated as disqualification for the positions. The Director, CSIR-IIIM reserves the right not to fill any or all advertised positions. Interim enquiries will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About CSIR-IIIM
content_sections.text: CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine, Jammu, is described in the notice as a premier institute working under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), an autonomous body under the Department of Scientific & Industrial Research (DSIR), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. Its address is Canal Road, Jammu, Jammu & Kashmir - 180001. The posts are project-based, purely temporary, and tenable at CSIR-IIIM, Jammu.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 posts in total, one position for each post code. The notice says the number of positions may vary depending on project requirements at the time of interview. It gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates with prior experience working in BSL-3 laboratories and handling BSL-2 and BSL-3 pathogens will be preferred. Those with experience in microbiology, molecular biology or related disciplines will also be preferred, along with expertise in drug efficacy and cytotoxicity assessment using ex vivo and in vivo models, and familiarity with enzymatic assays, gene expression profiling and target validation techniques, as demonstrated by peer-reviewed publications. Candidates with PhD in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Zoology from a recognized university or equivalent would be preferred. Candidates with previous experience in multistep organic synthesis, structural optimization, molecular modelling, pharmacokinetic profiling, AI modelling and scientific writing, as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications, will be preferred. Candidates with PhD in Chemistry from a recognized university or equivalent would be preferred. The upper age limit is 35 years for both posts. Age is reckoned as on the last date of application. Relaxation in age limit is given as per Govt. of India Rules; the notice prints no category-wise relaxation. All applicants must fulfil the essential qualification and other conditions as on the date of interview. Before applying, they should ensure they hold at least the essential qualifications as on the last date of application. For discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Zoology from a recognized university or equivalent.
M.Sc. Chemistry Degree from a recognized university or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry monthly emoluments of ₹56,000/- plus HRA. HRA is payable only if institutional accommodation is not availed or provided. The engagement is initially for one year or until the project duration, whichever is earlier. It may be extended or curtailed depending on the project duration, requirements and the performance or conduct of the incumbent. The current duration of the project is up to 21.05.2028. The tenure is co-terminus with the project. The total tenure cannot exceed five years, including engagement in all CSIR labs. Performance is reviewed periodically, and unsatisfactory performance may lead to termination without any notice or reason. The posts are purely temporary and on behalf of the sponsor. They give no right to a claim, implicit or explicit, for absorption on any post in CSIR-IIIM/CSIR.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-IIIM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Find the post you want in the vacancy table of the official notification (post code 01 Biology or post code 02 Chemistry). Use the "Click to Apply" link printed against that post in the notice. Apply on or before 18 November 2026. For queries on post code 1, email Dr. Rashmi Sharma at [email protected] . For queries on post code 2, email Dr. Parvinder Pal Singh at [email protected] . The notice does not list the fields of the online form or any documents to attach at the application stage.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is on the basis of an interview. If a large number of candidates apply, the Screening Committee may revisit the screening criteria, if required. The interview is online, through MS Teams. Candidates may interact with the Selection Committee in English or Hindi. Upon selection or empanelment, original documents, including eligibility qualification, DOB, caste and age relaxation certificate, are verified. If any discrepancy is found, the selection or empanelment stands cancelled. The notice does not give the interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates currently engaged in any project at CSIR-IIIM must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) before applying for any new vacancy. Their application, candidature or selection is considered only if the office has issued the NOC. Canvassing in any form is treated as disqualification for the positions. The Director, CSIR-IIIM reserves the right not to fill any or all advertised positions. Interim enquiries will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-IIIM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Med.) in Biology and one in Chemistry. The notice says the number of positions may vary with project requirements at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-IIIM Project Research Scientist-I posts?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 18 November 2026 (Wednesday).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist-I at CSIR-IIIM?
faq.answer: For Biology, a Post Graduate Degree in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Zoology from a recognized university or equivalent. For Chemistry, an M.Sc. Chemistry Degree from a recognized university or equivalent. A PhD in the same subject is preferred, not required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSIR-IIIM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for both posts, reckoned as on the last date of application. Relaxation is given as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Project Research Scientist-I at CSIR-IIIM?
faq.answer: The monthly emolument is ₹56,000/- plus HRA for both posts.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹56,000 pay?
faq.answer: HRA is paid in addition only if institutional accommodation is not availed or provided. If institutional accommodation is availed or provided, HRA is not paid.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CSIR-IIIM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Use the "Click to Apply" link given against the post in the notice, on or before 18 November 2026. Queries go to Dr. Rashmi Sharma (post code 1) or Dr. Parvinder Pal Singh (post code 2) at the email addresses printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSIR-IIIM Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of an interview conducted online through MS Teams. If many candidates apply, the Screening Committee may revisit the screening criteria.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSIR-IIIM Project Research Scientist-I job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary and project-based, initially for one year or until the project duration, whichever is earlier. The total tenure cannot exceed five years, and the posts confer no right to absorption in CSIR-IIIM/CSIR.

faq.question: Q10. Can current CSIR-IIIM project staff apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates currently engaged in any project at CSIR-IIIM must first obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC). Their application is considered only if the office has issued the NOC.
